name: Sequence files
description: Reads and writes FASTA files, shows them in notebooks, and treats two strands of one sequence as the same thing.
author: Acme Bio

importers.title: FASTA
importers.description: Reads a FASTA file into a table with a name, a length and the sequence for every record.

exporters.title: FASTA
exporters.description: Writes rows that have a name and a sequence column as a FASTA file.

previews.title: FASTA table
previews.description: Shows the records of a FASTA file with their length and GC content.

sameness-keys.title: Same sequence on either strand
sameness-keys.description: Two entries are the same thing when their sequence is the same, or the reverse complement of each other.
